_doc: Today's Walk (core/todays_walk.gd): text templates and the pick lists. {species}, {zone}, {pub}, {town}, {weather}, {reward} are filled in. Nothing counts days in a row, nothing is lost by missing one.

rewards.text: a cap full of field mushrooms

featured: Birders report {species} out in numbers around {zone}. Three times the usual, they reckon, so take a flask.
Walkers in {zone} say the {species} are everywhere this morning. Mind your step and your sandwiches.
A listener in {zone} rings in: {species}, dozens of them, bold as brass. Worth a wander if you're nearby.
pub: Over at {pub} in {town}, the quiz kitty's doubled tonight. Sharpen your pencils.
Quiz news: {pub} in {town} is paying double for tonight's prize. The landlord says he regrets nothing.
bounty: Today's bounty: catch anything at all in the {weather}, and there's {reward} for you at any Sanctuary, or right here.
Out in the {weather} today? Catch a creature in it and {reward} is yours. Collect from a nurse, or from me.
radio.bounty_done: Today's weather bounty has been claimed. Lovely work, that.
radio.bounty_paid: Ooh, and I hear you caught one in the {weather}. Here's {reward}, as promised.
close: That's Today's Walk. Tomorrow's will be different, and if you miss it, well, the hills aren't going anywhere.
That's Today's Walk. No rush, no register. Just a nice day out if you fancy one.

nurse_paid: Oh, you caught one in the {weather}! The wireless said there'd be a bounty. Here's {reward}.
menu: Today's Walk: {species} at {zone}, double quiz at {pub}, catch in {weather}.
